title: Create NFT
name: Name
mediaTypes: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP up to 20 MB · MP4 up to 200 MB
coverTypes: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP · up to 20 MB
invalidCover: Choose a readable PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP cover up to 20 MB.
notDeployed: The NFT creation contract has not been configured.
permanent: The artwork, metadata and royalty are permanent. Minting costs network gas; listing for sale is a separate step.
rights: I own this artwork or have permission to mint it.
membership: At least 6 Gnars in the selected wallet are required.
pending: Your creation request is saved. Check its status before sending another transaction.
failed: Unable to complete this step. Check the connection and try again.
uploadError: The upload could not be completed. No mint was sent.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Enable it before creating an NFT.
accountChanged: The selected wallet changed. Start again with the intended wallet.
reverted: The mint transaction reverted. No NFT was created by this transaction.
invalidMedia: Choose a readable image up to 20 MB or a playable MP4 up to 200 MB.
deployWarning: Permanent mainnet deployment. You pay gas. This custom contract has not received an independent audit. Deployment does not create an NFT.
royaltyHelp: Choose explicitly. This rate and recipient cannot be changed after deployment. ERC-2981 reports royalties; external marketplaces may not pay them.
deployAck: I have reviewed the permanent royalty and the contract source.
deployEoa: Use your external wallet to deploy. Smart wallets can mint after deployment.
deployPending: Deployment requested. Preserve its hash and verify before starting another deployment.
deployUnknown: No hash was returned. Check your wallet history; do not deploy again.
